name: Matutínum
intro: The night Office; historically prayed in the dark hours before dawn. The Church watches with the prophets and the angels, the longest and most ancient of the hours.

parts.label: Versicle & Response
parts.lat: Dómine, lábia mea apéries.
parts.eng: O Lord, Thou wilt open my lips.
parts.latR: Et os meum annuntiábit laudem tuam.
parts.engR: And my mouth shall declare Thy praise.

parts.label: Hymn
parts.title: Æterne rerum Cónditor
parts.lat:
Ætérne rerum Cónditor,
noctem diémque qui regis,
et témporum das témpora,
ut álleves fastídium.
parts.eng:
Eternal Maker of all things,
Who governest both night and day,
and grantest us the changing hours
to ease the labours of our way.

parts.label: Invitatory Antiphon
parts.lat: Veníte, adorémus Dóminum, quóniam ipse fecit nos.
parts.eng: Come, let us adore the Lord, for He hath made us.

verses.lat: Veníte, exsultémus Dómino: jubilémus Deo, salutári nostro:
verses.eng: Come, let us praise the Lord with joy: let us joyfully sing to God our Saviour.

verses.lat: Præoccupémus fáciem ejus in confessióne, et in psalmis jubilémus ei.
verses.eng: Let us come before His presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise to Him with psalms.

verses.lat: Quóniam Deus magnus Dóminus, et Rex magnus super omnes deos.
verses.eng: For the Lord is a great God, and a great King above all gods.

verses.lat: Veníte, adorémus, et procidámus ante Deum: plorémus coram Dómino, qui fecit nos.
verses.eng: Come, let us adore and fall down: and weep before the Lord that made us.

verses.lat: Beátus vir qui non ábiit in consílio impiórum, et in via peccatórum non stetit, et in cáthedra pestiléntiæ non sedit.
verses.eng: Blessed is the man who hath not walked in the counsel of the ungodly, nor stood in the way of sinners, nor sat in the chair of pestilence.

verses.lat: Sed in lege Dómini volúntas ejus, et in lege ejus meditábitur die ac nocte.
verses.eng: But his will is in the law of the Lord, and on His law he shall meditate day and night.

verses.lat: Et erit tamquam lignum quod plantátum est secus decúrsus aquárum, quod fructum suum dabit in témpore suo.
verses.eng: And he shall be like a tree which is planted near the running waters, which shall bring forth its fruit in due season.

verses.lat: Et fólium ejus non défluet; et ómnia quæcúmque fáciet prosperabúntur.
verses.eng: And his leaf shall not fall off; and all whatsoever he shall do shall prosper.

verses.lat: Non sic ímpii, non sic; sed tamquam pulvis quem próicit ventus a fácie terræ.
verses.eng: Not so the wicked, not so; but like the dust which the wind driveth from the face of the earth.

verses.lat: Quóniam novit Dóminus viam justórum; et iter impiórum períbit.
verses.eng: For the Lord knoweth the way of the just; and the way of the wicked shall perish.

verses.lat: Quare fremuérunt gentes, et pópuli meditáti sunt inánia?
verses.eng: Why have the Gentiles raged, and the people devised vain things?

verses.lat: Astitérunt reges terræ, et príncipes convenérunt in unum advérsus Dóminum et advérsus Christum ejus.
verses.eng: The kings of the earth stood up, and the princes met together, against the Lord and against His Christ.

verses.lat: Dirumpámus víncula eórum, et projiciámus a nobis jugum ipsórum.
verses.eng: Let us break their bonds asunder, and let us cast away their yoke from us.

verses.lat: Qui hábitat in cælis irridébit eos, et Dóminus subsannábit eos.
verses.eng: He that dwelleth in heaven shall laugh at them, and the Lord shall deride them.

verses.lat: Postula a me, et dabo tibi gentes hereditátem tuam, et possessiónem tuam términos terræ.
verses.eng: Ask of Me, and I will give Thee the Gentiles for Thy inheritance, and the utmost parts of the earth for Thy possession.

verses.lat: Servíte Dómino in timóre, et exsultáte ei cum tremóre. Apprehéndite disciplínam, ne quando irascátur Dóminus, et pereátis de via justa.
verses.eng: Serve ye the Lord with fear, and rejoice unto Him with trembling. Embrace discipline, lest at any time the Lord be angry, and you perish from the just way.

parts.label: Responsórium
parts.v1Lat: ℟. Veníte, adorémus, et procidámus ante Deum.
parts.v1Eng: Come, let us adore, and fall down before God.
parts.r1Lat: ℣. Plorémus coram Dómino, qui fecit nos.
parts.r1Eng: Let us weep before the Lord who made us.

parts.label: Capitulum
parts.lat: Tu autem in nobis es, Dómine, et nomen sanctum tuum invocátum est super nos: ne derelínquas nos, Dómine Deus noster.
parts.eng: But Thou, O Lord, art among us, and Thy holy name is called upon by us: forsake us not, O Lord our God.

parts.label: Hymnus Ambrosianus; Te Deum
parts.ref: Sundays and Feasts (omitted in Lent & Passiontide)

verses.lat: Te Deum laudámus: te Dóminum confitémur.
verses.eng: We praise Thee, O God: we acknowledge Thee to be the Lord.

verses.lat: Te ætérnum Patrem omnis terra venerátur.
verses.eng: All the earth doth worship Thee, the Father everlasting.

verses.lat: Tibi omnes Angeli, tibi Cæli et univérsæ Potestátes:
verses.eng: To Thee all Angels cry aloud, the Heavens and all the Powers therein.

verses.lat: Tibi Chérubim et Séraphim incessábili voce proclámant:
verses.eng: To Thee Cherubim and Seraphim continually do cry:

verses.lat: Sanctus, Sanctus, Sanctus, Dóminus Deus Sábaoth.
verses.eng: Holy, Holy, Holy, Lord God of Hosts.

verses.lat: Pleni sunt cæli et terra majestátis glóriæ tuæ.
verses.eng: Heaven and earth are full of the majesty of Thy glory.

verses.lat: Te gloriósus Apostolórum chorus, te Prophetárum laudábilis númerus,
verses.eng: The glorious company of the Apostles praise Thee, the goodly fellowship of the Prophets praise Thee,

verses.lat: Te Mártyrum candidátus laudat exércitus.
verses.eng: The noble army of Martyrs praise Thee.

verses.lat: Te per orbem terrárum sancta confitétur Ecclésia:
verses.eng: The holy Church throughout all the world doth acknowledge Thee:

verses.lat: Patrem imménsæ majestátis; venerándum tuum verum et únicum Fílium; Sanctum quoque Paráclitum Spíritum.
verses.eng: The Father of an infinite majesty; Thine honourable, true and only Son; also the Holy Ghost, the Comforter.

verses.lat: Tu Rex glóriæ, Christe. Tu Patris sempitérnus es Fílius.
verses.eng: Thou art the King of Glory, O Christ. Thou art the everlasting Son of the Father.

verses.lat: In te, Dómine, sperávi: non confúndar in ætérnum.
verses.eng: O Lord, in Thee have I trusted: let me never be confounded.

parts.label: Collect
parts.lat: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, qui vivórum domináris simul et mortuórum, omniúmque miseréris, quos tuos fide et ópere futúros esse prænóscis: te súpplices exorámus. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum. Amen.
parts.eng: Almighty, everlasting God, who hast dominion over both the living and the dead, and hast mercy on all whom Thou knowest will be Thine by faith and good works: we humbly beseech Thee. Through our Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.

parts.label: Conclusion
parts.lat: Benedicámus Dómino. Deo grátias.
parts.eng: Let us bless the Lord. Thanks be to God.

name: Laudes
intro: The morning praise; the first hour of light. The Church greets the new day with the Benedictus, the canticle of Zachary, sung as the sun rises.

parts.label: Opening
parts.lat: Deus, in adjutórium meum inténde.
parts.eng: O God, come to my assistance.
parts.latR: Dómine, ad adjuvándum me festína. Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
parts.engR: O Lord, make haste to help me. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.

parts.label: Hymn
parts.title: Splendor patérnæ glóriæ
parts.lat:
Splendor patérnæ glóriæ,
de luce lucem próferens,
lux lucis et fons lúminis,
diem dies illúminans.

Verúsque Sol, illábere,
micans nitóre pérpeti,
jubárque Sancti Spíritus
infúnde nostris sénsibus.

Votis vocémus et Patrem,
Patrem perénnis glóriæ,
Patrem poténtis grátiæ,
culpam reléget lúbricam.

Infórmet actus strénuos,
dentem retúndat ínvidi,
casus secúndet ásperos,
donétque gráte corpus.

Christus sit ipse méritus,
potúsque noster sit fides,
lætí bibámus sóbriam
ebrietátem Spíritus.

Lætus dies hic tránseat,
pudor sit ut dilúculum,
fides velut merídies,
crepúsculum mens nésciat.

Auróra cursus próvehit,
auróra totus pródeat,
in Patre totus Fílius,
et totus in Verbo Pater. Amen.
parts.eng:
O splendour of God's glory bright,
O Thou that bringest light from light,
O Light of light, light's living spring,
O Day, all days illumining.

O Thou true Sun, on us Thy glance
let fall in royal radiance,
the Spirit's sanctifying beam
upon our earthly senses stream.

The Father, too, our prayers implore,
Father of glory evermore,
the Father of all grace and might,
to banish sin from our delight.

He guides our acts with energy,
He blunts the teeth of enmity,
He turns to good each bitter ill,
and grants us grace our frame to fill.

Christ be our food, and faith our light,
and may the Spirit be our draught;
gladly we drink that sober feast
of holy rapture from the East.

O joyful be the passing day,
let modesty be as the dawn,
and faith as bright as noonday shine,
and let our souls no twilight know.

Dawn speeds the course of night away,
Dawn let the whole come forth as day,
in the Father the whole Son abide,
and all the Father in the Word. Amen.

parts.label: Antiphon
parts.lat: Allelúja, allelúja, allelúja.
parts.eng: Alleluia, alleluia, alleluia.

verses.lat: Deus, Deus meus, ad te de luce vígilo.
verses.eng: O God, my God, to Thee do I watch at break of day.

verses.lat: Sitívit in te ánima mea, quam multiplíciter tibi caro mea.
verses.eng: For Thee my soul hath thirsted; for Thee my flesh, O how many ways!

verses.lat: In terra desérta, et ínvia, et inaquósa: sic in sancto appárui tibi, ut vidérem virtútem tuam et glóriam tuam.
verses.eng: In a desert land, and where there is no way and no water: so in the sanctuary have I come before Thee, to see Thy power and Thy glory.

verses.lat: Quóniam mélior est misericórdia tua super vitas: lábia mea laudábunt te.
verses.eng: For Thy mercy is better than lives: Thee my lips shall praise.

verses.lat: Sic benedícam te in vita mea: et in nómine tuo levábo manus meas.
verses.eng: Thus will I bless Thee all my life long: and in Thy name I will lift up my hands.

verses.lat: Sicut ádipe et pinguédine repleátur ánima mea: et lábiis exsultatiónis laudábit os meum.
verses.eng: Let my soul be filled as with marrow and fatness: and my mouth shall praise Thee with joyful lips.

verses.lat: Si memor fui tui super stratum meum, in matutínis meditábor in te:
verses.eng: If I have remembered Thee upon my bed, I will meditate on Thee in the morning:

verses.lat: Quia fuísti adjútor meus, et in velaménto alárum tuárum exsultábo.
verses.eng: Because Thou hast been my helper, and I will rejoice under the covert of Thy wings.

verses.lat: Adhǽsit ánima mea post te: me suscépit déxtera tua.
verses.eng: My soul hath clung close to Thee: Thy right hand hath received me.

verses.lat: Ipsi vero in vanum quæsiérunt ánimam meam, introíbunt in inferióra terræ:
verses.eng: But they have sought my soul in vain, they shall go into the lower parts of the earth:

verses.lat: Tradéntur in manus gládii, partes vúlpium erunt.
verses.eng: They shall be delivered into the hands of the sword, they shall be the portions of foxes.

verses.lat: Rex vero lætábitur in Deo, laudabúntur omnes qui jurant in eo: quia obstrúctum est os loquéntium iníqua.
verses.eng: But the king shall rejoice in God, all they shall be praised that swear by Him: because the mouth is stopped of them that speak wicked things.

verses.lat: Deus misereátur nostri, et benedícat nobis: illúminet vultum suum super nos, et misereátur nostri.
verses.eng: May God have mercy on us, and bless us: may He cause the light of His countenance to shine upon us, and may He have mercy on us.

verses.lat: Ut cognoscámus in terra viam tuam, in ómnibus géntibus salutáre tuum.
verses.eng: That we may know Thy way upon earth: Thy salvation in all nations.

verses.lat: Confiteántur tibi pópuli, Deus: confiteántur tibi pópuli omnes.
verses.eng: Let the peoples praise Thee, O God: let all the peoples praise Thee.

verses.lat: Læténtur et exsúltent gentes: quóniam júdicas pópulos in æquitáte, et gentes in terra dírigis.
verses.eng: Let the nations be glad and rejoice: for Thou judgest the peoples with justice, and directest the nations upon earth.

verses.lat: Confiteántur tibi pópuli, Deus, confiteántur tibi pópuli omnes: terra dedit fructum suum.
verses.eng: Let the peoples praise Thee, O God, let all the peoples praise Thee: the earth hath yielded her fruit.

verses.lat: Benedícat nos Deus, Deus noster, benedícat nos Deus: et métuant eum omnes fines terræ.
verses.eng: May God, our God, bless us, may God bless us: and all the ends of the earth fear Him.

parts.label: Capitulum
parts.lat: Nox præcéssit, dies autem appropinquávit. Abjiciámus ergo ópera tenebrárum, et induámur arma lucis.
parts.eng: The night is passed, and the day is at hand. Let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and put on the armour of light.

verses.lat: Benedícite, ómnia ópera Dómini, Dómino: laudáte et superexaltáte eum in sǽcula.
verses.eng: All ye works of the Lord, bless the Lord: praise and exalt Him above all for ever.

verses.lat: Benedícite, Ángeli Dómini, Dómino: benedícite, cæli, Dómino.
verses.eng: O ye Angels of the Lord, bless the Lord: O ye heavens, bless the Lord.

verses.lat: Benedícite, aquæ omnes quæ super cælos sunt, Dómino: benedícite, omnes virtútes Dómini, Dómino.
verses.eng: O all ye waters that are above the heavens, bless the Lord: O all ye powers of the Lord, bless the Lord.

verses.lat: Benedícite, sol et luna, Dómino: benedícite, stellæ cæli, Dómino.
verses.eng: O ye sun and moon, bless the Lord: O ye stars of heaven, bless the Lord.

verses.lat: Benedícite, omnis imber et ros, Dómino: benedícite, omnes spíritus Dei, Dómino.
verses.eng: O every shower and dew, bless the Lord: O all ye spirits of God, bless the Lord.

verses.lat: Benedícite, ignis et æstus, Dómino: benedícite, frigus et æstus, Dómino.
verses.eng: O ye fire and heat, bless the Lord: O ye winter and summer, bless the Lord.

verses.lat: Benedícite, rores et pruína, Dómino: benedícite, gelu et frigus, Dómino.
verses.eng: O ye dews and hoar frosts, bless the Lord: O ye frost and cold, bless the Lord.

verses.lat: Benedícite, glácies et nives, Dómino: benedícite, noctes et dies, Dómino.
verses.eng: O ye ice and snow, bless the Lord: O ye nights and days, bless the Lord.

verses.lat: Benedícite, lux et ténebræ, Dómino: benedícite, fúlgura et nubes, Dómino.
verses.eng: O ye light and darkness, bless the Lord: O ye lightnings and clouds, bless the Lord.

verses.lat: Benedícat terra Dóminum: laudet et superexáltet eum in sǽcula.
verses.eng: O let the earth bless the Lord: let it praise and exalt Him above all for ever.

verses.lat: Benedícite, montes et colles, Dómino: benedícite, univérsa germinántia in terra, Dómino.
verses.eng: O ye mountains and hills, bless the Lord: O all ye things that spring up in the earth, bless the Lord.

verses.lat: Benedícite, fontes, Dómino: benedícite, mária et flúmina, Dómino.
verses.eng: O ye fountains, bless the Lord: O ye seas and rivers, bless the Lord.

verses.lat: Benedícite, cete et ómnia quæ movéntur in aquis, Dómino: benedícite, omnes vólucres cæli, Dómino.
verses.eng: O ye whales, and all that move in the waters, bless the Lord: O all ye fowls of the air, bless the Lord.

verses.lat: Benedícite, omnes béstiæ et pécora, Dómino: benedícite, fílii hóminum, Dómino.
verses.eng: O all ye beasts and cattle, bless the Lord: O ye sons of men, bless the Lord.

verses.lat: Benedícat Israël Dóminum: laudet et superexáltet eum in sǽcula.
verses.eng: O let Israel bless the Lord: let them praise and exalt Him above all for ever.

verses.lat: Benedícite, sacerdótes Dómini, Dómino: benedícite, servi Dómini, Dómino.
verses.eng: O ye priests of the Lord, bless the Lord: O ye servants of the Lord, bless the Lord.

verses.lat: Benedícite, spíritus et ánimæ justórum, Dómino: benedícite, sancti et húmiles corde, Dómino.
verses.eng: O ye spirits and souls of the just, bless the Lord: O ye holy and humble of heart, bless the Lord.

verses.lat: Benedícite, Ananía, Azaría, Mísaël, Dómino: laudáte et superexaltáte eum in sǽcula.
verses.eng: O Ananias, Azarias, and Misael, bless the Lord: praise and exalt Him above all for ever.

verses.lat: Benedícámus Patrem et Fílium cum Sancto Spíritu: laudémus et superexaltémus eum in sǽcula.
verses.eng: Let us bless the Father and the Son, with the Holy Ghost: let us praise and exalt Him above all for ever.

verses.lat: Benedíctus es, Dómine, in firmaménto cæli: et laudábilis, et gloriósus, et superexaltátus in sǽcula.
verses.eng: Blessed art Thou, O Lord, in the firmament of heaven: and worthy of praise, and glorious, and exalted above all for ever.

verses.lat: Benedíctus Dóminus Deus Israël, quia visitávit et fecit redemptiónem plebis suæ:
verses.eng: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel: because He hath visited and wrought the redemption of His people.

verses.lat: Et eréxit cornu salútis nobis, in domo David púeri sui.
verses.eng: And hath raised up an horn of salvation to us, in the house of David His servant.

verses.lat: Sicut locútus est per os sanctórum, qui a sǽculo sunt, prophetárum ejus:
verses.eng: As He spoke by the mouth of His holy prophets, who are from the beginning:

verses.lat: Salútem ex inimícis nostris, et de manu ómnium qui odérunt nos.
verses.eng: Salvation from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us.

verses.lat: Ad faciéndam misericórdiam cum pátribus nostris: et memorári testaménti sui sancti.
verses.eng: To perform mercy to our fathers, and to remember His holy testament.

verses.lat: Jusjurándum quod jurávit ad Abraham patrem nostrum, datúrum se nobis:
verses.eng: The oath which He swore to Abraham our father, that He would grant to us:

verses.lat: Ut sine timóre, de manu inimicórum nostrórum liberáti, serviámus illi,
verses.eng: That being delivered from the hand of our enemies, we may serve Him without fear,

verses.lat: In sanctitáte et justítia coram ipso, ómnibus diébus nostris.
verses.eng: In holiness and justice before Him, all our days.

verses.lat: Et tu, puer, Prophéta Altíssimi vocáberis: præíbis enim ante fáciem Dómini, paráre vias ejus:
verses.eng: And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest: for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare His ways.

verses.lat: Ad dandam sciéntiam salútis plebi ejus: in remissiónem peccatórum eórum:
verses.eng: To give knowledge of salvation to His people, unto the remission of their sins.

verses.lat: Per víscera misericórdiæ Dei nostri: in quibus visitávit nos Oriens ex alto:
verses.eng: Through the bowels of the mercy of our God: in which the Orient from on high hath visited us.

verses.lat: Illumináre his qui in ténebris et in umbra mortis sedent: ad dirigéndos pedes nostros in viam pacis.
verses.eng: To enlighten them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death: to direct our feet into the way of peace.

parts.label: Collect
parts.lat: Dómine Deus omnípotens, qui ad princípium hujus diéi nos perveníre fecísti: tua nos hódie salva virtúte; ut in hac die ad nullum declinémus peccátum, sed semper ad tuam justítiam faciéndam nostra procédant elóquia, dirigántur cogitatiónes et ópera. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum. Amen.
parts.eng: O Lord, almighty God, who hast brought us to the beginning of this day: defend us in the same by Thy power; that during this day we may fall into no sin, but that all our words may proceed and all our thoughts and works be directed to the doing of Thy justice. Through our Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.

parts.label: Conclusion
parts.lat: Benedicámus Dómino. Deo grátias.
parts.eng: Let us bless the Lord. Thanks be to God.

name: Prima
intro: The first daylight hour. A short hour to sanctify the day's work and offer the day's actions to God.

parts.label: Opening
parts.lat: Deus, in adjutórium meum inténde.
parts.eng: O God, come to my assistance.
parts.latR: Dómine, ad adjuvándum me festína. Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
parts.engR: O Lord, make haste to help me. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.

parts.label: Hymn
parts.title: Iam lucis orto sídere
parts.lat:
Iam lucis orto sídere,
Deum precémur súpplices,
ut in diúrnis áctibus
nos servet a nocéntibus.

Linguam refrénans témperet,
ne litis horror ínsonet;
visum fovéndo cóntegat,
ne vanitátes háuriat.

Sint pura cordis íntima,
absístat et vecórdia;
carnis terat supérbiam
potus cibíque párcitas.

Ut cum dies abscésserit,
noctémque sors redúxerit,
mundi per abstinéntiam
ipsi canámus glóriam.

Deo Patri sit glória,
ejúsque soli Fílio,
cum Spíritu Paráclito,
nunc et per omne sǽculum. Amen.
parts.eng:
Now in the sun's new dawning ray,
lowly of heart, our God we pray
that He, in all we do or say,
would keep us free from harm today.

May He restrain our tongues from strife,
and shield from wrath our stumbling life,
and wrap around our eyesight keen
a guard lest vanity creep in.

May every heart be pure within,
and folly find no place therein;
let sparing use of meat and drink
the pride of flesh to nothing shrink.

So when the light of day is gone,
and night in course shall follow on,
through abstinence from worldly stain
we may His glory sing again.

All praise to God the Father be,
all praise to Thee, Eternal Son,
all praise, O Holy Paraclete,
while age on endless age shall run. Amen.

parts.label: Antiphon
parts.lat: Allelúja, allelúja, allelúja.
parts.eng: Alleluia, alleluia, alleluia.

verses.lat: Confitémini Dómino, quóniam bonus, quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: Give praise to the Lord, for He is good, for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Dicat nunc Israel, quóniam bonus, quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: Let Israel now say that He is good, that His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Dicat nunc domus Aaron, quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: Let the house of Aaron now say, that His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Dicant nunc qui timent Dóminum, quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: Let them that fear the Lord now say, that His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: De tribulatióne invocávi Dóminum, et exaudívit me in latitúdine Dóminus.
verses.eng: In my trouble I called upon the Lord, and the Lord heard me and enlarged me.

verses.lat: Dóminus mihi adjútor; non timébo quid fáciat mihi homo.
verses.eng: The Lord is my helper; I will not fear what man can do unto me.

verses.lat: Dóminus mihi adjútor, et ego despíciam inimícos meos.
verses.eng: The Lord is my helper, and I will look over my enemies.

verses.lat: Bonum est confídere in Dómino, quam confídere in hómine.
verses.eng: It is good to confide in the Lord, rather than to have confidence in man.

verses.lat: Bonum est speráre in Dómino, quam speráre in princípibus.
verses.eng: It is good to trust in the Lord, rather than to trust in princes.

verses.lat: Omnes gentes circuiérunt me; et in nómine Dómini quia ultus sum in eos.
verses.eng: All nations compassed me about; and in the name of the Lord I have been revenged on them.

verses.lat: Circumdántes circumdedérunt me; et in nómine Dómini quia ultus sum in eos.
verses.eng: Surrounding me they compassed me about; and in the name of the Lord I have been revenged on them.

verses.lat: Circumdedérunt me sicut apes, et exarsérunt sicut ignis in spinis; et in nómine Dómini quia ultus sum in eos.
verses.eng: They surrounded me like bees, and they blazed like fire among thorns; and in the name of the Lord I was revenged on them.

verses.lat: Impúlsus, eversus sum ut cáderem; et Dóminus suscépit me.
verses.eng: Being pushed I was overturned that I might fall; but the Lord supported me.

verses.lat: Fortitúdo mea et laus mea Dóminus, et factus est mihi in salútem.
verses.eng: The Lord is my strength and my praise, and He is become my salvation.

verses.lat: Vox exsultatiónis et salútis in tabernáculis justórum.
verses.eng: The voice of rejoicing and of salvation is in the tabernacles of the just.

verses.lat: Déxtera Dómini fecit virtútem, déxtera Dómini exaltávit me; déxtera Dómini fecit virtútem.
verses.eng: The right hand of the Lord hath wrought strength; the right hand of the Lord hath exalted me; the right hand of the Lord hath wrought strength.

verses.lat: Non móriar, sed vivam, et narrábo ópera Dómini.
verses.eng: I shall not die, but live, and shall declare the works of the Lord.

verses.lat: Castígans castigávit me Dóminus, et morti non trádidit me.
verses.eng: The Lord chastising hath chastised me, but He hath not delivered me over to death.

verses.lat: Aperíte mihi portas justítiæ; ingréssus in eas confitébor Dómino.
verses.eng: Open ye to me the gates of justice; I will go in to them and give praise to the Lord.

verses.lat: Hæc porta Dómini; justi intrábunt in eam.
verses.eng: This is the gate of the Lord; the just shall enter into it.

verses.lat: Confitébor tibi, quóniam exaudísti me, et factus es mihi in salútem.
verses.eng: I will give praise to Thee, because Thou hast heard me, and art become my salvation.

verses.lat: Lápidem quem reprobavérunt ædificántes, hic factus est in caput ánguli.
verses.eng: The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner.

verses.lat: A Dómino factum est istud, et est mirábile in óculis nostris.
verses.eng: This is the Lord's doing, and it is wonderful in our eyes.

verses.lat: Hæc est dies quam fecit Dóminus; exsultémus et lætémur in ea.
verses.eng: This is the day which the Lord hath made; let us be glad and rejoice therein.

verses.lat: O Dómine, salvum me fac; o Dómine, bene prosperáre.
verses.eng: O Lord, save me; O Lord, give good success.

verses.lat: Benedíctus qui venit in nómine Dómini; benedíximus vobis de domo Dómini.
verses.eng: Blessed be He that cometh in the name of the Lord; we have blessed you out of the house of the Lord.

verses.lat: Deus Dóminus, et illúxit nobis. Constitúite diem solémnem in condénsis, usque ad cornu altáris.
verses.eng: The Lord is God, and He hath shone upon us. Appoint a solemn day with shady boughs, even to the horn of the altar.

verses.lat: Deus meus es tu, et confitébor tibi; Deus meus es tu, et exaltábo te.
verses.eng: Thou art my God, and I will praise Thee; Thou art my God, and I will exalt Thee.

verses.lat: Confitémini Dómino, quóniam bonus, quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: O praise ye the Lord, for He is good, for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Deus, in nómine tuo salvum me fac, et in virtúte tua júdica me.
verses.eng: Save me, O God, by Thy name, and judge me in Thy strength.

verses.lat: Deus, exáudi oratiónem meam; áuribus pércipe verba oris mei.
verses.eng: O God, hear my prayer; give ear to the words of my mouth.

verses.lat: Quóniam aliéni insurrexérunt advérsum me, et fortes quæsiérunt ánimam meam; et non proposuérunt Deum ante conspéctum suum.
verses.eng: For strangers have risen up against me, and the mighty have sought after my soul; and they have not set God before their eyes.

verses.lat: Ecce enim Deus ádjuvat me, et Dóminus suscéptor est ánimæ meæ.
verses.eng: For behold God is my helper, and the Lord is the protector of my soul.

verses.lat: Avérte mala inimícis meis, et in veritáte tua dispérde illos.
verses.eng: Turn back the evils upon my enemies, and cut them off in Thy truth.

verses.lat: Voluntárie sacrificábo tibi, et confitébor nómini tuo, Dómine, quóniam bonum est.
verses.eng: I will freely sacrifice to Thee, and will give praise, O God, to Thy name, because it is good.

verses.lat: Quóniam ex omni tribulatióne eripuísti me, et super inimícos meos despéxit óculus meus.
verses.eng: For Thou hast delivered me out of all trouble, and my eye hath looked down upon my enemies.

parts.label: Capitulum
parts.lat: Regi sæculórum immortáli et invisíbili, soli Deo honor et glória in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
parts.eng: To the King of ages, immortal, invisible, the only God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.

parts.label: Collect
parts.lat: Dómine Deus omnípotens, qui ad princípium hujus diéi nos perveníre fecísti: tua nos hódie salva virtúte; ut in hac die ad nullum declinémus peccátum, sed semper ad tuam justítiam faciéndam nostra procédant elóquia, dirigántur cogitatiónes et ópera. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum. Amen.
parts.eng: O Lord, almighty God, who hast brought us to the beginning of this day: defend us in the same by Thy power; that during this day we may fall into no sin, but that all our words may proceed and all our thoughts and works be directed to the doing of Thy justice. Through our Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.

parts.label: Conclusion
parts.lat: Benedicámus Dómino. Deo grátias.
parts.eng: Let us bless the Lord. Thanks be to God.

name: Tértia
intro: The third hour; when the Holy Ghost descended upon the Apostles at Pentecost. Pray for the gifts of the Holy Spirit.

parts.label: Opening
parts.lat: Deus, in adjutórium meum inténde.
parts.eng: O God, come to my assistance.
parts.latR: Dómine, ad adjuvándum me festína. Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
parts.engR: O Lord, make haste to help me. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.

parts.label: Hymn
parts.title: Nunc, Sancte, nobis Spíritus
parts.lat:
Nunc, Sancte, nobis Spíritus,
unum Patri cum Fílio,
dignáre promptus íngeri
nostro refúsus péctori.

Os, lingua, mens, sensus, vigor,
confessiónem pérsonent;
flamméscat igne cáritas,
accéndat ardor próximos.

Præsta, Pater piíssime,
Patríque compar Únice,
cum Spíritu Paráclito
regnans per omne sǽculum. Amen.
parts.eng:
Come, Holy Ghost, who ever One
reignest with Father and with Son,
it is the hour, our souls possess
with Thy full flood of holiness.

Let flesh and heart and lips and mind
sound forth our witness to mankind;
and love light up our mortal frame,
till others catch the living flame.

Grant this, O Father, ever One
with Christ, Thy sole-begotten Son,
and Holy Ghost, whom all adore,
reigning and blest for evermore. Amen.

parts.label: Antiphon
parts.lat: Allelúja, allelúja, allelúja.
parts.eng: Alleluia, alleluia, alleluia.

verses.lat: Adhǽsit paviménto ánima mea; vivífica me secúndum verbum tuum.
verses.eng: My soul hath cleaved to the pavement; quicken Thou me according to Thy word.

verses.lat: Vias meas enuntiávi, et exaudísti me; doce me justificatiónes tuas.
verses.eng: I have declared my ways, and Thou hast heard me; teach me Thy justifications.

verses.lat: Viam justificatiónum tuárum ínstrue me, et exercébor in mirabílibus tuis.
verses.eng: Make me to understand the way of Thy justifications, and I shall be exercised in Thy wondrous works.

verses.lat: Dormitávit ánima mea præ tǽdio; confírma me in verbis tuis.
verses.eng: My soul hath slumbered through heaviness; strengthen Thou me in Thy words.

verses.lat: Viam iniquitátis ámove a me, et de lege tua miserére mei.
verses.eng: Remove from me the way of iniquity, and out of Thy law have mercy on me.

verses.lat: Viam veritátis elégi; judícia tua non sum oblítus.
verses.eng: I have chosen the way of truth; Thy judgments I have not forgotten.

verses.lat: Adhǽsi testimóniis tuis, Dómine; noli me confúndere.
verses.eng: I have stuck to Thy testimonies, O Lord; put me not to shame.

verses.lat: Viam mandatórum tuórum cucúrri, cum dilatásti cor meum.
verses.eng: I have run the way of Thy commandments, when Thou didst enlarge my heart.

verses.lat: Legem pone mihi, Dómine, viam justificatiónum tuárum, et exquíram eam semper.
verses.eng: Set before me for a law the way of Thy justifications, O Lord, and I will always seek after it.

verses.lat: Da mihi intelléctum, et scrutábor legem tuam, et custódiam illam in toto corde meo.
verses.eng: Give me understanding, and I will search Thy law, and I will keep it with my whole heart.

verses.lat: Deduc me in sémitam mandatórum tuórum, quia ipsam vólui.
verses.eng: Lead me into the path of Thy commandments, for this same I have desired.

verses.lat: Inclína cor meum in testimónia tua, et non in avarítiam.
verses.eng: Incline my heart unto Thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.

verses.lat: Avérte óculos meos, ne vídeant vanitátem; in via tua vivífica me.
verses.eng: Turn away my eyes that they may not behold vanity; quicken me in Thy way.

verses.lat: Státue servo tuo elóquium tuum, in timóre tuo.
verses.eng: Establish Thy word to Thy servant, in Thy fear.

verses.lat: Amputa oppróbrium meum, quod suspicátus sum, quia judícia tua jucúnda.
verses.eng: Turn away my reproach, which I have apprehended, for Thy judgments are delightful.

verses.lat: Ecce concupívi mandáta tua; in æquitáte tua vivífica me.
verses.eng: Behold I have longed after Thy precepts; quicken me in Thy justice.

verses.lat: Et véniat super me misericórdia tua, Dómine; salutáre tuum secúndum elóquium tuum.
verses.eng: Let Thy mercy also come upon me, O Lord; Thy salvation according to Thy word.

verses.lat: Et respondébo exprobrántibus mihi verbum, quia sperávi in sermónibus tuis.
verses.eng: So shall I answer them that reproach me in anything, that I have trusted in Thy words.

verses.lat: Et ne áuferas de ore meo verbum veritátis usquequáque, quia in judíciis tuis supersperávi.
verses.eng: And take not Thou the word of truth utterly out of my mouth, for in Thy words I have hoped exceedingly.

verses.lat: Et custódiam legem tuam semper, in sǽculum et in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.eng: So shall I always keep Thy law, for ever and ever.

verses.lat: Et ambulábam in latitúdine, quia mandáta tua exquisívi.
verses.eng: And I walked at large, because I have sought after Thy commandments.

verses.lat: Et loquébar in testimóniis tuis in conspéctu regum, et non confundébar.
verses.eng: And I spoke of Thy testimonies before kings, and I was not ashamed.

verses.lat: Et meditábar in mandátis tuis, quæ diléxi.
verses.eng: And I meditated on Thy commandments, which I loved.

verses.lat: Et levávi manus meas ad mandáta tua, quæ diléxi; et exercébar in justificatiónibus tuis.
verses.eng: And I lifted up my hands to Thy commandments, which I loved; and I was exercised in Thy justifications.

parts.label: Capitulum
parts.lat: Sana me, Dómine, et sanábor: salvum me fac, et salvus ero: quóniam laus mea tu es.
parts.eng: Heal me, O Lord, and I shall be healed: save me, and I shall be saved, for Thou art my praise.

parts.label: Collect
parts.lat: Dómine Deus omnípotens, qui ad princípium hujus diéi nos perveníre fecísti: tua nos hódie salva virtúte; ut in hac die ad nullum declinémus peccátum, sed semper ad tuam justítiam faciéndam nostra procédant elóquia, dirigántur cogitatiónes et ópera. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum. Amen.
parts.eng: O Lord, almighty God, who hast brought us to the beginning of this day: defend us in the same by Thy power; that during this day we may fall into no sin, but that all our words may proceed and all our thoughts and works be directed to the doing of Thy justice. Through our Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.

parts.label: Conclusion
parts.lat: Benedicámus Dómino. Deo grátias.
parts.eng: Let us bless the Lord. Thanks be to God.

name: Sexta
intro: The sixth hour; noon. The hour at which Our Lord was nailed to the Cross. A pause in the day's work to remember His sacrifice.

parts.label: Opening
parts.lat: Deus, in adjutórium meum inténde.
parts.eng: O God, come to my assistance.
parts.latR: Dómine, ad adjuvándum me festína. Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
parts.engR: O Lord, make haste to help me. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.

parts.label: Hymn
parts.title: Rector potens, verax Deus
parts.lat:
Rector potens, verax Deus,
qui témperas rerum vices,
splendóre mane illúminas,
et ígnibus merídiem.

Exstíngue flammas lítium,
aufer calórem nóxium,
confer salútem córporum,
verámque pacem córdium.

Præsta, Pater piíssime,
Patríque compar Únice,
cum Spíritu Paráclito
regnans per omne sǽculum. Amen.
parts.eng:
O God of truth, O Lord of might,
who orderest time and change aright,
who send'st the early morning ray,
and light'st with splendour all the day.

Extinguish Thou each sinful fire,
and banish every ill desire;
and while Thou keep'st the body whole,
shed forth Thy peace upon the soul.

Grant this, O Father, ever One
with Christ, Thy sole-begotten Son,
and Holy Ghost, whom all adore,
reigning and blest for evermore. Amen.

parts.label: Antiphon
parts.lat: Allelúja, allelúja, allelúja.
parts.eng: Alleluia, alleluia, alleluia.

parts.label: Psalm 122; Ad te levávi óculos meos

verses.lat: Ad te levávi óculos meos, qui hábitas in cælis.
verses.eng: To Thee have I lifted up my eyes, who dwellest in heaven.

verses.lat: Ecce sicut óculi servórum in mánibus dominórum suórum,
verses.eng: Behold, as the eyes of servants are on the hands of their masters,

verses.lat: Sicut óculi ancíllæ in mánibus dóminæ suæ; ita óculi nostri ad Dóminum Deum nostrum, donec misereátur nostri.
verses.eng: As the eyes of the handmaid are on the hands of her mistress; so are our eyes unto the Lord our God, until He have mercy on us.

verses.lat: Miserére nostri, Dómine, miserére nostri, quia multum repléti sumus despectióne;
verses.eng: Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us, for we are greatly filled with contempt;

verses.lat: Quia multum repléta est ánima nostra; oppróbrium abundántibus, et despéctio supérbis.
verses.eng: For our soul is greatly filled; we are a reproach to the rich, and contempt to the proud.

verses.lat: Nisi quia Dóminus erat in nobis, dicat nunc Israel;
verses.eng: Unless the Lord had been in us, let Israel now say;

verses.lat: Nisi quia Dóminus erat in nobis, cum exsúrgerent hómines in nos,
verses.eng: Unless the Lord had been in us, when men rose up against us,

verses.lat: Forte vivos deglutíssent nos;
verses.eng: Perhaps they had swallowed us up alive.

verses.lat: Cum irascerétur furor eórum in nos, fórsitan aqua absorbuísset nos.
verses.eng: When their fury was enkindled against us, perhaps the waters had swallowed us up.

verses.lat: Torréntem pertransívit ánima nostra; fórsitan pertransísset ánima nostra aquam intolerábilem.
verses.eng: Our soul hath passed through a torrent; perhaps our soul had passed through a water insupportable.

verses.lat: Benedíctus Dóminus, qui non dedit nos in captiónem déntibus eórum.
verses.eng: Blessed be the Lord, who hath not given us to be a prey to their teeth.

verses.lat: Anima nostra sicut passer erépta est de láqueo venántium;
verses.eng: Our soul hath been delivered as a sparrow out of the snare of the fowlers;

verses.lat: Láqueus contrítus est, et nos liberáti sumus. Adjutórium nostrum in nómine Dómini, qui fecit cælum et terram.
verses.eng: The snare is broken, and we are delivered. Our help is in the name of the Lord, who made heaven and earth.

verses.lat: Qui confídunt in Dómino, sicut mons Sion; non commovébitur in ætérnum, qui hábitat in Jerúsalem.
verses.eng: They that trust in the Lord shall be as Mount Sion; he shall not be moved for ever that dwelleth in Jerusalem.

verses.lat: Montes in circúitu ejus; et Dóminus in circúitu pópuli sui, ex hoc nunc et usque in sǽculum.
verses.eng: Mountains are round about it; so the Lord is round about His people, from henceforth now and for ever.

verses.lat: Quia non relínquet Dóminus virgam peccatórum super sortem justórum, ut non exténdant justi ad iniquitátem manus suas.
verses.eng: For the Lord will not leave the rod of sinners upon the lot of the just, that the just may not stretch forth their hands to iniquity.

verses.lat: Benefac, Dómine, bonis et rectis corde.
verses.eng: Do good, O Lord, to those that are good, and to the upright of heart.

verses.lat: Declinántes autem in obligatiónes addúcet Dóminus cum operántibus iniquitátem; pax super Israel.
verses.eng: But such as turn aside into bonds, the Lord shall lead out with the workers of iniquity; peace upon Israel.

parts.label: Capitulum
parts.lat: Alter altérius ónera portáte, et sic adimplébitis legem Christi.
parts.eng: Bear ye one another's burdens; and so you shall fulfil the law of Christ.

parts.label: Collect
parts.lat: Dómine Deus omnípotens, qui ad princípium hujus diéi nos perveníre fecísti: tua nos hódie salva virtúte; ut in hac die ad nullum declinémus peccátum, sed semper ad tuam justítiam faciéndam nostra procédant elóquia, dirigántur cogitatiónes et ópera. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum. Amen.
parts.eng: O Lord, almighty God, who hast brought us to the beginning of this day: defend us in the same by Thy power; that during this day we may fall into no sin, but that all our words may proceed and all our thoughts and works be directed to the doing of Thy justice. Through our Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.

parts.label: Conclusion
parts.lat: Benedicámus Dómino. Deo grátias.
parts.eng: Let us bless the Lord. Thanks be to God.

name: Nona
intro: The ninth hour; three in the afternoon. The hour at which Our Lord died upon the Cross. Adore Him with the centurion: 'Truly this was the Son of God.'

parts.label: Opening
parts.lat: Deus, in adjutórium meum inténde.
parts.eng: O God, come to my assistance.
parts.latR: Dómine, ad adjuvándum me festína. Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
parts.engR: O Lord, make haste to help me. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.

parts.label: Hymn
parts.title: Rerum Deus tenax vigor
parts.lat:
Rerum Deus tenax vigor,
immótus in te pérmanens,
lucis diúrnæ témpora
succéssibus detérminans.

Largíre lumen véspere,
quo vita nusquam décidas;
sed prǽmium mortis sacræ
perénnis instet glória.

Præsta, Pater piíssime,
Patríque compar Únice,
cum Spíritu Paráclito
regnans per omne sǽculum. Amen.
parts.eng:
O strength and stay upholding all creation,
who ever dost Thyself unmoved abide,
yet day by day the light in due gradation
from hour to hour through all its changes guide.

Grant to life's day a calm unclouded ending,
an eve untouched by shadows of decay,
the brightness of a holy deathbed blending
with dawning glories of th'eternal day.

Grant this, O Father, ever One
with Christ, Thy sole-begotten Son,
and Holy Ghost, whom all adore,
reigning and blest for evermore. Amen.

parts.label: Antiphon
parts.lat: Allelúja, allelúja, allelúja.
parts.eng: Alleluia, alleluia, alleluia.

verses.lat: In converténdo Dóminus captivitátem Sion, facti sumus sicut consoláti.
verses.eng: When the Lord brought back the captivity of Sion, we became like men comforted.

verses.lat: Tunc replétum est gáudio os nostrum, et lingua nostra exsultatióne.
verses.eng: Then was our mouth filled with gladness, and our tongue with joy.

verses.lat: Tunc dicent inter gentes: Magnificávit Dóminus fácere cum eis.
verses.eng: Then shall they say among the Gentiles: The Lord hath done great things for them.

verses.lat: Magnificávit Dóminus fácere nobíscum; facti sumus lætántes.
verses.eng: The Lord hath done great things for us; we are become joyful.

verses.lat: Convérte, Dómine, captivitátem nostram, sicut torrens in Austro.
verses.eng: Turn again our captivity, O Lord, as a stream in the south.

verses.lat: Qui séminant in lácrimis, in exsultatióne metent.
verses.eng: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.

verses.lat: Eúntes ibant et flebant, mitténtes sémina sua. Veniéntes autem vénient cum exsultatióne, portántes manípulos suos.
verses.eng: Going they went and wept, casting their seeds. But coming they shall come with joyfulness, carrying their sheaves.

verses.lat: Nisi Dóminus ædificáverit domum, in vanum laboravérunt qui ǽdificant eam.
verses.eng: Unless the Lord build the house, they labour in vain that build it.

verses.lat: Nisi Dóminus custodíerit civitátem, frustra vígilat qui custódit eam.
verses.eng: Unless the Lord keep the city, he watcheth in vain that keepeth it.

verses.lat: Vanum est vobis ante lucem súrgere; súrgite postquam sedéritis, qui manducátis panem dolóris.
verses.eng: It is vain for you to rise before light; rise ye after you have sitten, you that eat the bread of sorrow.

verses.lat: Cum déderit diléctis suis somnum, ecce heréditas Dómini, fílii; merces, fructus ventris.
verses.eng: When He shall give sleep to His beloved, behold the inheritance of the Lord are children; the reward, the fruit of the womb.

verses.lat: Sicut sagíttæ in manu poténtis, ita fílii excussórum.
verses.eng: As arrows in the hand of the mighty, so the children of them that have been shaken.

verses.lat: Beátus vir qui implévit desidérium suum ex ipsis; non confundétur, cum loquétur inimícis suis in porta.
verses.eng: Blessed is the man that hath filled his desire with them; he shall not be confounded when he shall speak to his enemies in the gate.

verses.lat: Beáti omnes qui timent Dóminum, qui ámbulant in viis ejus.
verses.eng: Blessed are all they that fear the Lord, that walk in His ways.

verses.lat: Labóres mánuum tuárum quia manducábis; beátus es, et bene tibi erit.
verses.eng: For thou shalt eat the labours of thy hands; blessed art thou, and it shall be well with thee.

verses.lat: Uxor tua sicut vitis abúndans in latéribus domus tuæ.
verses.eng: Thy wife as a fruitful vine on the sides of thy house.

verses.lat: Fílii tui sicut novéllæ olivárum in circúitu mensæ tuæ.
verses.eng: Thy children as olive plants round about thy table.

verses.lat: Ecce sic benedicétur homo qui timet Dóminum.
verses.eng: Behold, thus shall the man be blessed that feareth the Lord.

verses.lat: Benedícat tibi Dóminus ex Sion; et vídeas bona Jerúsalem ómnibus diébus vitæ tuæ. Et vídeas fílios filiórum tuórum; pax super Israel.
verses.eng: May the Lord bless thee out of Sion; and mayest thou see the good things of Jerusalem all the days of thy life. And mayest thou see thy children's children; peace upon Israel.

parts.label: Capitulum
parts.lat: Quia Deus miséricors Dóminus Deus tuus est: non dimíttet te, nec omníno discoóperit, neque obliviscétur testaménti, in quo jurávit pátribus tuis.
parts.eng: For the Lord thy God is a merciful God: He will not leave thee, nor altogether destroy thee, nor forget the covenant by which He swore to thy fathers.

parts.label: Collect
parts.lat: Dómine Deus omnípotens, qui ad princípium hujus diéi nos perveníre fecísti: tua nos hódie salva virtúte; ut in hac die ad nullum declinémus peccátum, sed semper ad tuam justítiam faciéndam nostra procédant elóquia, dirigántur cogitatiónes et ópera. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum. Amen.
parts.eng: O Lord, almighty God, who hast brought us to the beginning of this day: defend us in the same by Thy power; that during this day we may fall into no sin, but that all our words may proceed and all our thoughts and works be directed to the doing of Thy justice. Through our Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.

parts.label: Conclusion
parts.lat: Benedicámus Dómino. Deo grátias.
parts.eng: Let us bless the Lord. Thanks be to God.

name: Vésperæ
intro: The evening hour; when the sun sets and the lamps are lit. The Church sings the Magnificat, Our Lady's canticle of praise, the second great hinge-hour of the day.

parts.label: Opening
parts.lat: Deus, in adjutórium meum inténde.
parts.eng: O God, come to my assistance.
parts.latR: Dómine, ad adjuvándum me festína. Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
parts.engR: O Lord, make haste to help me. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.

parts.label: Hymn
parts.title: Lucis Creátor óptime
parts.lat:
Lucis Creátor óptime,
lucem diérum próferens,
primórdiis lucis novæ,
mundi parans oríginem.

Qui mane junctum vésperi
diem vocári prǽcipis:
illábitur tetrum chaos,
audi preces cum flétibus.

Ne mens graváta crímine
vitæ sit exsul múnere,
dum nil perénne cógitat,
seséque culpis ílligat.

Cæléste pulset óstium,
vitále tollat prǽmium:
vitémus omne nóxium,
purgémus omne péssimum.

Præsta, Pater piíssime,
Patríque compar Únice,
cum Spíritu Paráclito
regnans per omne sǽculum. Amen.
parts.eng:
O blest Creator of the light,
who mak'st the day with radiance bright,
and o'er the forming world didst call
the light from chaos first of all.

Whose wisdom joined in meet array
the morn and eve, and named them Day:
night comes with all its darkling fears;
regard Thy people's prayers and tears.

Lest, sunk in sin, and whelm'd with strife,
they lose the gift of endless life;
while thinking but the thoughts of time,
they weave new chains of woe and crime.

But grant them grace that they may strain
the heavenly gate and prize to gain:
each harmful lure aside to cast,
and purge away each error past.

Grant this, O Father, ever One
with Jesus Christ, Thine only Son,
and Holy Ghost, whom all adore,
reigning and blest for evermore. Amen.

parts.label: Antiphon
parts.lat: Dirigátur, Dómine, orátio mea, sicut incénsum in conspéctu tuo.
parts.eng: Let my prayer be directed, O Lord, as incense in Thy sight.

verses.lat: Dixit Dóminus Dómino meo: Sede a dextris meis.
verses.eng: The Lord said to my Lord: Sit Thou at my right hand.

verses.lat: Donec ponam inimícos tuos, scabéllum pedum tuórum.
verses.eng: Until I make Thy enemies Thy footstool.

verses.lat: Virgam virtútis tuæ emíttet Dóminus ex Sion: domináre in médio inimicórum tuórum.
verses.eng: The Lord will send forth the sceptre of Thy power out of Sion: rule Thou in the midst of Thy enemies.

verses.lat: Tecum princípium in die virtútis tuæ in splendóribus sanctórum: ex útero ante lucíferum génui te.
verses.eng: With Thee is the principality in the day of Thy strength, in the brightness of the saints: from the womb before the day-star I begot Thee.

verses.lat: Jurávit Dóminus, et non pænitébit eum: Tu es sacérdos in ætérnum secúndum órdinem Melchísedech.
verses.eng: The Lord hath sworn, and He will not repent: Thou art a priest for ever according to the order of Melchisedech.

verses.lat: Dóminus a dextris tuis, confrégit in die iræ suæ reges.
verses.eng: The Lord at Thy right hand hath broken kings in the day of His wrath.

verses.lat: De torrénte in via bibet: proptérea exaltábit caput.
verses.eng: He shall drink of the torrent in the way: therefore shall He lift up the head.

verses.lat: Confitébor tibi, Dómine, in toto corde meo, in consílio justórum et congregatióne.
verses.eng: I will praise Thee, O Lord, with my whole heart, in the council of the just and in the congregation.

verses.lat: Magna ópera Dómini, exquisíta in omnes voluntátes ejus.
verses.eng: Great are the works of the Lord, sought out according to all His wills.

verses.lat: Conféssio et magnificéntia opus ejus, et justítia ejus manet in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.eng: His work is praise and magnificence, and His justice continueth for ever and ever.

verses.lat: Memóriam fecit mirabílium suórum, miséricors et miserátor Dóminus; escam dedit timéntibus se.
verses.eng: He hath made a remembrance of His wonderful works, being a merciful and gracious Lord; He hath given food to them that fear Him.

verses.lat: Memor erit in sǽculum testaménti sui; virtútem óperum suórum annuntiábit pópulo suo.
verses.eng: He will be mindful for ever of His covenant; He will show forth to His people the power of His works.

verses.lat: Ut det illis hereditátem géntium: ópera mánuum ejus véritas et judícium.
verses.eng: That He may give them the inheritance of the Gentiles: the works of His hands are truth and judgment.

verses.lat: Fidélia ómnia mandáta ejus, confirmáta in sǽculum sǽculi, facta in veritáte et æquitáte.
verses.eng: All His commandments are faithful, confirmed for ever and ever, made in truth and equity.

verses.lat: Redemptiónem misit pópulo suo; mandávit in ætérnum testaméntum suum.
verses.eng: He hath sent redemption to His people; He hath commanded His covenant for ever.

verses.lat: Sanctum et terríbile nomen ejus: inítium sapiéntiæ timor Dómini.
verses.eng: Holy and terrible is His name: the fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom.

verses.lat: Intelléctus bonus ómnibus faciéntibus eum: laudátio ejus manet in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.eng: A good understanding to all that do it: His praise continueth for ever and ever.

verses.lat: Beátus vir qui timet Dóminum; in mandátis ejus volet nimis.
verses.eng: Blessed is the man that feareth the Lord; he shall delight exceedingly in His commandments.

verses.lat: Potens in terra erit semen ejus; generátio rectórum benedicétur.
verses.eng: His seed shall be mighty upon earth; the generation of the righteous shall be blessed.

verses.lat: Glória et divítiæ in domo ejus, et justítia ejus manet in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.eng: Glory and wealth shall be in his house, and his justice remaineth for ever and ever.

verses.lat: Exórtum est in ténebris lumen rectis; miséricors, et miserátor, et justus.
verses.eng: To the righteous a light is risen up in darkness; he is merciful, and compassionate, and just.

verses.lat: Jucúndus homo qui miserétur et cómmodat; dispónet sermónes suos in judício, quia in ætérnum non commovébitur.
verses.eng: Acceptable is the man that showeth mercy and lendeth; he shall order his words with judgment, because he shall not be moved for ever.

verses.lat: In memória ætérna erit justus; ab auditióne mala non timébit.
verses.eng: The just shall be in everlasting remembrance; he shall not fear the evil hearing.

verses.lat: Parátum cor ejus speráre in Dómino, confirmátum est cor ejus; non commovébitur donec despíciat inimícos suos.
verses.eng: His heart is ready to hope in the Lord, his heart is strengthened; he shall not be moved until he look over his enemies.

verses.lat: Dispérsit, dedit paupéribus; justítia ejus manet in sǽculum sǽculi: cornu ejus exaltábitur in glória.
verses.eng: He hath distributed, he hath given to the poor; his justice remaineth for ever and ever: his horn shall be exalted in glory.

verses.lat: Peccátor vidébit et irascétur; déntibus suis fremet et tabéscet.
verses.eng: The wicked shall see and shall be angry; he shall gnash with his teeth and pine away.

verses.lat: Desidérium peccatórum períbit.
verses.eng: The desire of the wicked shall perish.

verses.lat: Laudáte, púeri, Dóminum; laudáte nomen Dómini.
verses.eng: Praise the Lord, ye children; praise ye the name of the Lord.

verses.lat: Sit nomen Dómini benedíctum, ex hoc nunc et usque in sǽculum.
verses.eng: Blessed be the name of the Lord, from henceforth now and for ever.

verses.lat: A solis ortu usque ad occásum, laudábile nomen Dómini.
verses.eng: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same, the name of the Lord is worthy of praise.

verses.lat: Excélsus super omnes gentes Dóminus, et super cælos glória ejus.
verses.eng: The Lord is high above all nations, and His glory above the heavens.

verses.lat: Quis sicut Dóminus Deus noster, qui in altis hábitat, et humília réspicit in cælo et in terra?
verses.eng: Who is as the Lord our God, who dwelleth on high, and looketh down on the low things in heaven and in earth?

verses.lat: Súscitans a terra ínopem, et de stércore érigens páuperem.
verses.eng: Raising up the needy from the earth, and lifting up the poor out of the dunghill.

verses.lat: Ut cóllocet eum cum princípibus, cum princípibus pópuli sui.
verses.eng: That He may place him with princes, with the princes of His people.

verses.lat: Qui habitáre facit stérilem in domo, matrem filiórum lætántem.
verses.eng: Who maketh a barren woman to dwell in a house, the joyful mother of children.

parts.label: Capitulum
parts.lat: Benedíctus Deus, et Pater Dómini nostri Iesu Christi, Pater misericordiárum, et Deus totíus consolatiónis, qui consolátur nos in omni tribulatióne nostra.
parts.eng: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort, who comforteth us in all our tribulation.

verses.lat: Magníficat ánima mea Dóminum:
verses.eng: My soul doth magnify the Lord:

verses.lat: Et exsultávit spíritus meus in Deo salutári meo.
verses.eng: And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.

verses.lat: Quia respéxit humilitátem ancíllæ suæ: ecce enim ex hoc beátam me dicent omnes generatiónes.
verses.eng: Because He hath regarded the humility of His handmaid: for behold from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.

verses.lat: Quia fecit mihi magna qui potens est: et sanctum nomen ejus.
verses.eng: Because He that is mighty hath done great things to me: and holy is His name.

verses.lat: Et misericórdia ejus a progénie in progénies timéntibus eum.
verses.eng: And His mercy is from generation unto generations, to them that fear Him.

verses.lat: Fecit poténtiam in bráchio suo: dispérsit supérbos mente cordis sui.
verses.eng: He hath showed might in His arm: He hath scattered the proud in the conceit of their heart.

verses.lat: Depósuit poténtes de sede, et exaltávit húmiles.
verses.eng: He hath put down the mighty from their seat, and hath exalted the humble.

verses.lat: Esuriéntes implévit bonis: et dívites dimísit inánes.
verses.eng: He hath filled the hungry with good things: and the rich He hath sent empty away.

verses.lat: Suscépit Israël púerum suum, recordátus misericórdiæ suæ.
verses.eng: He hath received Israel His servant, being mindful of His mercy.

verses.lat: Sicut locútus est ad patres nostros, Abraham et sémini ejus in sǽcula.
verses.eng: As He spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and to his seed for ever.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.

verses.lat: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

parts.label: Collect
parts.lat: Dómine Deus omnípotens, qui ad princípium hujus diéi nos perveníre fecísti: tua nos hódie salva virtúte; ut in hac die ad nullum declinémus peccátum, sed semper ad tuam justítiam faciéndam nostra procédant elóquia, dirigántur cogitatiónes et ópera. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum. Amen.
parts.eng: O Lord, almighty God, who hast brought us to the beginning of this day: defend us in the same by Thy power; that during this day we may fall into no sin, but that all our words may proceed and all our thoughts and works be directed to the doing of Thy justice. Through our Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.

parts.label: Conclusion
parts.lat: Benedicámus Dómino. Deo grátias.
parts.eng: Let us bless the Lord. Thanks be to God.

name: Completórium
intro: The night prayer; the Church's last word before sleep. Traditional Roman Compline opens with a blessing and the Confiteor, then moves through psalmody to the Nunc Dimittis and the seasonal Marian antiphon. The hour ends with the soul commended into God's hands.

parts.label: Blessing
parts.lat: Iube, dómne, benedícere.
parts.eng: Pray, sir, a blessing.
parts.latR: Noctem quiétam et finem perféctum concédat nobis Dóminus omnípotens. Amen.
parts.engR: May the almighty Lord grant us a quiet night and a perfect end. Amen.

parts.label: Short Reading (1 Peter 5:8-9)
parts.lat: Frátres: sóbrii estóte, et vigiláte: quia adversárius vester diábolus tamquam leo rúgiens círcuit, quærens quem dévoret: cui resístite fortes in fide.
parts.eng: Brethren: be sober and watch; for your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, goeth about seeking whom he may devour. Resist ye him, strong in faith.
parts.latR: Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis. Deo grátias.
parts.engR: But Thou, O Lord, have mercy on us. Thanks be to God.

parts.label: Supplication
parts.lat: Convérte nos, Deus, salutáris noster.
parts.eng: Convert us, O God our Saviour.
parts.latR: Et avérte iram tuam a nobis.
parts.engR: And turn away Thine anger from us.

parts.label: Opening
parts.lat: Deus, in adjutórium meum inténde.
parts.eng: O God, come to my assistance.
parts.latR: Dómine, ad adjuvándum me festína. Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
parts.engR: O Lord, make haste to help me. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.

parts.label: Antiphon
parts.lat: Miserére mihi, Dómine, et exáudi oratiónem meam.
parts.eng: Have mercy on me, O Lord, and hear my prayer.

verses.lat: Cum invocárem, exaudívit me Deus justítiæ meæ; in tribulatióne dilatásti mihi.
verses.eng: When I called upon Him, the God of my justice heard me; when I was in distress, Thou hast enlarged me.

verses.lat: Miserére mei, et exáudi oratiónem meam.
verses.eng: Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.

verses.lat: Fílii hóminum, úsquequo gravi corde? Ut quid dilígitis vanitátem, et quǽritis mendácium?
verses.eng: O ye sons of men, how long will you be dull of heart? Why do you love vanity and seek after lying?

verses.lat: Et scitóte quóniam mirificávit Dóminus sanctum suum: Dóminus exáudiet me cum clamávero ad eum.
verses.eng: Know ye also that the Lord hath made His holy one wonderful: the Lord will hear me when I shall cry unto Him.

verses.lat: Irascímini, et nolíte peccáre; quæ dícitis in córdibus vestris, in cubílibus vestris compungímini.
verses.eng: Be angry and sin not; the things you say in your hearts, be sorry for them upon your beds.

verses.lat: Sacrificáte sacrifícium justítiæ, et speráte in Dómino. Multi dicunt: Quis osténdit nobis bona?
verses.eng: Offer up the sacrifice of justice, and trust in the Lord. Many say: Who showeth us good things?

verses.lat: Signátum est super nos lumen vultus tui, Dómine: dedísti lætítiam in corde meo.
verses.eng: The light of Thy countenance, O Lord, is signed upon us: Thou hast given gladness in my heart.

verses.lat: A fructu fruménti, vini et ólei sui, multiplicáti sunt.
verses.eng: By the fruit of their corn, their wine, and oil, they are multiplied.

verses.lat: In pace in idípsum dórmiam et requiéscam; quóniam tu, Dómine, singuláriter in spe constituísti me.
verses.eng: In peace in the selfsame I will sleep and I will rest; for Thou, O Lord, singularly hast settled me in hope.

verses.lat: In te, Dómine, sperávi, non confúndar in ætérnum: in justítia tua líbera me.
verses.eng: In Thee, O Lord, have I hoped, let me never be confounded: deliver me in Thy justice.

verses.lat: Inclína ad me aurem tuam, accélera ut éruas me.
verses.eng: Bow down Thy ear to me: make haste to deliver me.

verses.lat: Esto mihi in Deum protectórem, et in domum refúgii, ut salvum me fácias.
verses.eng: Be Thou unto me a God, a protector, and a house of refuge, to save me.

verses.lat: Quóniam fortitúdo mea et refúgium meum es tu; et propter nomen tuum dedúces me et enútries me.
verses.eng: For Thou art my strength and my refuge; and for Thy name's sake Thou wilt lead me and nourish me.

verses.lat: Edúces me de láqueo hoc quem abscondérunt mihi, quóniam tu es protéctor meus.
verses.eng: Thou wilt bring me out of this snare which they have hidden for me; for Thou art my protector.

verses.lat: In manus tuas comméndo spíritum meum: redemísti me, Dómine, Deus veritátis.
verses.eng: Into Thy hands I commend my spirit: Thou hast redeemed me, O Lord, the God of truth.

verses.lat: Qui hábitat in adjutório Altíssimi, in protectióne Dei cæli commorábitur.
verses.eng: He that dwelleth in the aid of the Most High shall abide under the protection of the God of heaven.

verses.lat: Dicet Dómino: Suscéptor meus es tu et refúgium meum; Deus meus, sperábo in eum.
verses.eng: He shall say to the Lord: Thou art my protector and my refuge; my God, in Him will I trust.

verses.lat: Quóniam ipse liberávit me de láqueo venántium et a verbo áspero.
verses.eng: For He hath delivered me from the snare of the hunters and from the sharp word.

verses.lat: Scápulis suis obumbrábit tibi, et sub pennis ejus sperábis.
verses.eng: He will overshadow thee with His shoulders, and under His wings thou shalt trust.

verses.lat: Scuto circúmdabit te véritas ejus; non timébis a timóre noctúrno.
verses.eng: His truth shall compass thee with a shield; thou shalt not be afraid of the terror of the night.

verses.lat: A sagítta volánte in die, a negótio perambulánte in ténebris, ab incúrsu et dæmónio meridiáno.
verses.eng: Of the arrow that flieth in the day, of the business that walketh about in the dark, of invasion, or of the noonday devil.

verses.lat: Cadent a látere tuo mille, et decem míllia a dextris tuis; ad te autem non appropiábit.
verses.eng: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.

verses.lat: Verúmtamen óculis tuis considerábis, et retributiónem peccatórum vidébis.
verses.eng: But thou shalt consider with thy eyes, and shalt see the reward of the wicked.

verses.lat: Quóniam tu es, Dómine, spes mea; Altíssimum posuísti refúgium tuum.
verses.eng: Because Thou, O Lord, art my hope; Thou hast made the Most High thy refuge.

verses.lat: Non accédet ad te malum, et flagéllum non appropinquábit tabernáculo tuo.
verses.eng: There shall no evil come to thee, nor shall the scourge come near thy dwelling.

verses.lat: Quóniam Ángelis suis mandávit de te, ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis.
verses.eng: For He hath given His Angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.

verses.lat: In mánibus portábunt te, ne forte offéndas ad lápidem pedem tuum.
verses.eng: In their hands they shall bear thee up, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.

verses.lat: Super áspidem et basilíscum ambulábis, et conculcábis leónem et dracónem.
verses.eng: Thou shalt walk upon the asp and the basilisk, and thou shalt trample under foot the lion and the dragon.

verses.lat: Quóniam in me sperávit, liberábo eum; prótegam eum, quóniam cognóvit nomen meum.
verses.eng: Because he hoped in Me, I will deliver him; I will protect him, because he hath known My name.

verses.lat: Clamábit ad me, et ego exáudiam eum; cum ipso sum in tribulatióne, erípiam eum et glorificábo eum.
verses.eng: He shall cry to Me, and I will hear him; I am with him in tribulation, I will deliver him, and I will glorify him.

verses.lat: Longitúdine diérum replébo eum, et osténdam illi salutáre meum.
verses.eng: I will fill him with length of days, and I will show him My salvation.

verses.lat: Ecce nunc benedícite Dóminum, omnes servi Dómini.
verses.eng: Behold, now bless ye the Lord, all ye servants of the Lord.

verses.lat: Qui statis in domo Dómini, in átriis domus Dei nostri.
verses.eng: Who stand in the house of the Lord, in the courts of the house of our God.

verses.lat: In nóctibus extóllite manus vestras in sancta, et benedícite Dóminum.
verses.eng: In the nights lift up your hands to the holy places, and bless ye the Lord.

verses.lat: Benedícat te Dóminus ex Sion, qui fecit cælum et terram.
verses.eng: May the Lord out of Sion bless thee, He that made heaven and earth.

parts.label: Hymn
parts.title: Te lucis ante términum
parts.lat:
Te lucis ante términum,
rerum Creátor, póscimus,
ut pro tua cleméntia
sis præsul et custódia.

Procul recédant sómnia,
et nóctium phantásmata;
hostémque nostrum cómprime,
ne polluántur córpora.

Præsta, Pater piíssime,
Patríque compar Únice,
cum Spíritu Paráclito
regnans per omne sǽculum. Amen.
parts.eng:
To Thee before the close of day,
Creator of the world, we pray:
that with Thy wonted favour Thou
wouldst be our guard and keeper now.

From all ill dreams defend our sight,
from fears and terrors of the night;
withhold from us our ghostly foe,
that spot of sin we may not know.

O Father, that we ask be done,
through Jesus Christ, Thine only Son,
who, with the Holy Ghost and Thee,
doth live and reign eternally. Amen.

parts.label: Capitulum
parts.lat: Tu autem in nobis es, Dómine, et nomen sanctum tuum invocátum est super nos: ne derelínquas nos, Dómine Deus noster.
parts.eng: But Thou, O Lord, art among us, and Thy holy name is called upon by us: forsake us not, O Lord our God.

parts.label: Responsory
parts.v1Lat: In manus tuas, Dómine, comméndo spíritum meum.
parts.v1Eng: Into Thy hands, O Lord, I commend my spirit.
parts.r1Eng: Thou hast redeemed us, O Lord, the God of truth.
parts.v2Lat: Custódi nos, Dómine, ut pupíllam óculi.
parts.v2Eng: Keep us, O Lord, as the apple of Thine eye.
parts.r2Lat: Sub umbra alárum tuárum prótege nos.
parts.r2Eng: Protect us under the shadow of Thy wings.

verses.lat: Nunc dimíttis servum tuum, Dómine, secúndum verbum tuum in pace:
verses.eng: Now Thou dost dismiss Thy servant, O Lord, according to Thy word in peace:

verses.lat: Quia vidérunt óculi mei salutáre tuum,
verses.eng: Because my eyes have seen Thy salvation,

verses.lat: Quod parásti ante fáciem ómnium populórum:
verses.eng: Which Thou hast prepared before the face of all peoples:

verses.lat: Lumen ad revelatiónem géntium, et glóriam plebis tuæ Israël.
verses.eng: A light to the revelation of the Gentiles, and the glory of Thy people Israel.

parts.label: Collect
parts.lat: Vísita, quǽsumus, Dómine, habitatiónem istam, et omnes insídias inimíci ab ea longe repélle: Angeli tui sancti hábitent in ea, qui nos in pace custódiant. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum. Amen.
parts.eng: Visit, we beseech Thee, O Lord, this dwelling, and drive far from it all snares of the enemy: let Thy holy Angels dwell herein, to preserve us in peace. Through our Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.

parts.label: Marian Antiphon
parts.lat: Salve, Regína, Mater misericórdiæ, vita, dulcédo et spes nostra, salve. Ad te clamámus, éxsules fílii Hevæ. Ad te suspirámus, geméntes et flentes in hac lacrimárum valle. Eja ergo, advocáta nostra, illos tuos misericórdes óculos ad nos convérte. Et Jesum, benedíctum fructum ventris tui, nobis post hoc exsílium osténde. O clemens, o pia, o dulcis Virgo María.
parts.eng: Hail, holy Queen, Mother of mercy, our life, our sweetness, and our hope. To thee do we cry, poor banished children of Eve. To thee do we send up our sighs, mourning and weeping in this valley of tears. Turn then, most gracious Advocate, thine eyes of mercy toward us. And after this our exile, show unto us the blessed fruit of thy womb, Jesus. O clement, O loving, O sweet Virgin Mary.
